[In exercise of the
powers conferred by sub‑section (1) of section 46 of the Mines Act, 1923
(IV of 1923), and in supersession of all
previous notifications on the subject, in this behalf, the Central Government
exempted the mines, groups and classes of mines, and classes of persons
specified in the first column of the schedule annexed hereto from the
operations of the provisions of the Mines Act, 1923 (IV of 1923), which are
specified in the corresponding entry in the second column thereof, subject to
the conditions specified in the cor responding entry in the third column
thereof.)
